title: R02 overlay v2 selector response draft

custom_invariants: selected_candidate_id exists in the exact bound payload
every field_refs item is a valid RFC 6901 pointer into the exact bound payload
candidate-scoped references resolve to the selected candidate unless the reason is an explicit comparison
unknown missing duplicate or wrong-scope references fail closed
free text and portfolio edits are forbidden
RFC 6901 decoding occurs exactly once and only ~0 and ~1 escapes are accepted
array reference tokens use canonical nonnegative decimal indexes without leading zeros and must be in bounds
the RFC 6901 hyphen append token is forbidden
